status: exploratory reused pilot captures; no fresh holdout
hypothesis: With identical per-token normalization and identical values in each 6x6 block, spatial placement can change astcenc reconstruction and attention error. A globally fixed D4 orientation may be a cheap same-cache-bit candidate; no orientation is selected before observing this experiment.
extension_rule: Run remaining 23 capture/layer pairs only when pilot controls pass and pilot wall time is <=30 seconds; stop between pairs at 180 seconds overall. Never extend based on quality gains.
normalization: token; fp16_floor(min), fp16_ceil(max-offset), normalized once before transforms
transform_contract: D4 and random36 apply the same bijection to all normalized padded 6x6 blocks. Inverse each block before trimming padding and denormalizing with unchanged original token metadata. Whole-block negative control moves full normalized blocks within each head, then inverse orders payload and reconstruction. All maps use only fixed constants/seed and dimensions, never Q, K, V or errors.
padding: D=64 edge-pad to66 before transforms; padded values are part of the fixed block multiset; exclude padding from original tensor/attention metrics

negative_criteria.map_inverse: Every transform is bijective and inverse restores synthetic coordinates exactly; all eight D4 maps distinct
negative_criteria.unchanged_ranges_values: Per-block normalized sorted values exactly unchanged for local transforms; token FP16 offsets/scales computed once and reused
negative_criteria.identity_reference: Identity payload bytes, decoded tensor and byte counts exactly equal existing encode_tensor scalar6/token result
negative_criteria.whole_block: After inverse permutation, payload bytes and decoded values exactly equal identity for every block
negative_criteria.finite: All reconstructions and metrics finite; any failure aborts quality interpretation and extension

metrics.primary: FP64 causal GQA fixed original Q/K: relative L2 = sqrt(sum ||P_prefix*(Vdecoded-V)||^2 / sum ||P*V||^2), aggregated by summed SSE, never mean relative L2
metrics.secondary: Original-prefix tensor relative L2/MSE; normalized reconstruction SSE; practical V-only snapshot with K and V tail rounded FP16; per-capture and per-layer primary aggregates
metrics.astc_modes: Read 11-bit block-mode identifiers and partition counts directly from each 16-byte payload using vendored astcenc physical format. Group normalized and original-prefix tensor SSE by mode; associations are descriptive, not causal proof about modes. No encoder mode search knobs are changed.
metrics.selection: Report every predefined variant. Any best global D4 orientation is exploratory and requires new frozen confirmation; no fitted per-block orientation or Q-dependent selection. No significance or novelty claim.

memory: ASTC payload and FP16 ranges identical size for all variants. D4 has zero per-cache transform metadata using fixed coordinate arithmetic. Diagnostic random36 additionally reports36 uint8 map bytes shared globally. Whole-block control reports uint16 block-index map bytes shared across heads; neither diagnostic map is a same-cache-bit candidate. GPU indexing/latency and allocation unmeasured.
budget: CPU only, one process, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1; at most24 pairs x10 variants plus identity reference; no model/library downloads; save new outputs only
